definitions: A reason or set of reasons given with the aim of persuading others that an action or idea is right or wrong.
An exchange of diverging or opposite views, typically a heated or angry one.
A series of statements typically used to persuade someone of something or to present a point of view.
A fact or piece of information offered as proof or evidence.
The subject matter of a work of art, or a summary of this.
One of the independent variables of a function.
The angle of a complex number when represented on an Argand diagram.
examples: There was a strong argument for the new policy.
They had a heated argument about money.
The lawyer presented a compelling argument.
The main argument of the play is love versus duty.
Calculate the argument of the complex number.
